description: Compact (150-row), live-app-uploadable dataset in the real ingestion schema (customer_id, amount, invoice_date, status, reason). Exercises every pipeline stage: already-paid rows skipped at ingestion, small failed payments auto-approved, large failed payments escalated, one exact-duplicate pair and, on re-ingestion of the same file, correctly recognized as a duplicate (verified live: duplicate_event=127, cases_created=0). All four recognized failure reasons represented.
intended_use: DEMONSTRATION -- upload through the running app's own UI.
